notes: Phobos Manufacturing charge machines: footprint, dry mass, idle and working power, the share of the working power that warms the room, feed-bin cells, art, INSTALL tab and use and power points (pixels from the centre). A read-only reference for now: a saved machine's mass and footprint depend on these, so a player file that changes one is refused. Balance record: docs/development/manufacturing-refinery-and-chemistry.md.

PhobosVolatilesRefinery.notes: Fennmark V4 Volatiles Refinery: an electric hearth and drying retort, one exact charge at a time.

PhobosLeachUnit.notes: Lixivar LC-3 Leach and Crystallise Unit: a heated leach tank and a closed crystalliser with condensate recovery, one selected charge at a time. 12 kW sets every recipe's energy through its seconds.

PhobosAcidPlant.notes: Lixivar SA-3 Sulfuric Acid Plant: a fluidised-bed roaster, a converter bed and an absorption tower, one nodule at a time. Its 4 kW runs the blowers, preheat and pumps; the reactions themselves release about 21.1 kWh a charge into the room.

PhobosFermenterStill.notes: Alembrine Copperhead-3 Fermenter-Still (Manufacturing 0.39.0): two fermentation vats, a copper pot still and a condenser, one charge of beets or sugar at a time. Its 3 kW heats the still and runs the pumps; nearly all of it ends up in the room through the condenser.

PhobosElectrolysisCell.notes: Oxsmith EC-4 Electrolysis Cell (Manufacturing 0.52.0): a cold-walled molten-rock cell, one lump of loose regolith or one chunk of Silicates ore at a time. Its 60 kW melts the charge and drives the current that splits iron and silicon oxides; a regolith charge's reactions absorb 27.0 of its 60 kWh, and the rest, 55 percent, warms the room (before the player's machine heat setting).
